diagnosis: The Strawberry GraphQL team avatar upload mutation uploads an avatar image and updates team branding using team_id from the GraphQL arguments. Although the resolver checks authentication, it fails to check whether current_user is a member or administrator of team_id. Any authenticated user can overwrite profile pictures and brand assets of other teams.
exploit_request:
